sources.title: Top 5 Reranking Models to Improve RAG Results
sources.snippet: In this article, you will learn how reranking improves the relevance of results in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems by going beyond what retrievers alone can achieve. Topics we will cover include: How rerankers refine retriever outputs to deliver better answers Five top reranker models to test in 2026 Final thoughts on choosing the right reranker for your system Let's get started.
